methods.screenshots: All10 matched BEFORE and all10 fresh AFTER screenshots plus desktop terminal Undo and780px Harbor–Bell highlight inspected at source image resolution. Root separately inspected the selected additional gameplay screenshots.
methods.motion: Decoded retained uncut motion WebMs at4fps with FFmpeg. Contact sheets used only as an index;12 selected AFTER frames and4 matching BEFORE reverse-transit frames individually inspected at original1440x900. This is ordered decoded-frame inspection, not a claim of real-time native-GPU playback.
methods.geometry: Four actual-UI browser cases independently compare the rendered Line position buffers with the ferry world pose, interior heading, water-relative route/wake positions and per-action traveled-distance monotonicity. See environment-journey-samples.json and extra-capture-manifest.json for raw samples and actual route buffers.
methods.limitation: Headless Chromium SwiftShader software rendering; phone inputs/viewports emulated.25fps is encoded-video cadence, not measured game frame rate or a physical-device claim.

findings: Actual course, curved steering, attached passengers, short wake and final broadside docking are coherent in the reviewed temporal samples, with matching actual-buffer/pose/tangent assertions passing both Harbor–Bell and outer-bend directions.

A disabled local-context card can briefly overlap the loaded ferry during Bell→Harbor transit. BEFORE frame107(~26.5s) covers part of the passengers/boat; AFTER frames86–87(~21.25–21.5s) show a smaller top/ear overlap, and88(~21.75s) is clear. This confirms a pre-existing occurrence.4fps samples do not establish exact duration or prove whether duration changed.

Matched BEFORE/AFTER WebMs are motion-comparison evidence. AFTER29.08s encoded tail stops at turn13 before visible final unloading/terminal, although its actual UI trace verifies won14. The separately retained environment-uninterrupted.webm includes a30-rendered-frame visible-success hold and is the completion handoff clip.

completionTail.observed: 14 actions, Home3/3, empty ferry, all three residents ashore, Bellwater is safe terminal, terminal Undo and Restart all visible. Original video remains uncut.
